name: PromptCraft PR and MR Policy
purpose: Define the review contract for pull requests and merge requests.
requiredContent: screenshots or recordings if UI changed
rollback note if the change is risky
reviewChecklist: Tests or manual verification are listed
New UI still works in light and dark mode
AI usage is documented if applicable
mergeRules: Do not merge if the checklist is incomplete
Do not merge if the diff is too broad
Do not merge if the PR message is vague
Do not merge if the branch contains unrelated edits
Do not merge if a risky AI-backed change is unreviewed
